summary: GoldMining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and NYSE American, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) furnishing a news release dated October 6, 2026, reporting initial 2026 diamond drill assays from its 100%-owned Yarumalito gold-copper porphyry project in Antioquia, Colombia. Hole YAR-45 returned 399.9 metres at 0.45 g/t gold-equivalent from surface; four holes totaling 1,218 metres were completed, with assays for YAR-46 to YAR-48 pending. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated; the filing is routine exploration disclosure, not a special situation.
